rationale: With only 26 minutes to close and the stock sitting at 96% of its intraday range near the session high ($39.74), the risk/reward for a long is poor — minimal upside buffer before the high acts as resistance and forced liquidation at close adds execution risk. A short against the trend (price above 9-EMA, strong relative volume, positive SPY day) is equally unattractive. The negative earnings miss news is already 22+ hours old and largely priced in given the gap-up open, leaving no clear mechanical edge in either direction this late in the session.
